lastResponse.text: I hear you, and we can keep this low-pressure. I won’t call police unless you ask, or if there’s immediate life danger. If you feel in danger right now, call nine one one. If not, a safer next step is the day center: 247 Southeast eighty second Avenue, Portland. I’ll repeat: 2-4-7, Southeast eighty second Avenue. You can ask for same-day youth support and a safer Place for tonight without sharing more than you want.
